name: Reclaim.ai
tagline: AI calendar that auto-schedules tasks, habits, and focus time.
description: Reclaim.ai is an AI calendar assistant that automatically schedules tasks, recurring habits, and protected focus time around your meetings, syncing Google and Outlook calendars to prevent double-booking. It auto-defends deep-work blocks, adds buffer time, and finds optimal meeting slots, with time-tracking analytics on top.
insight: Founded in 2019 in Portland, Oregon, and acquired by Dropbox in August 2024.

modelSupport.notes: Scheduling is driven by Reclaim's own optimization engine rather than a chat LLM.

edge: Defends focus time additively around your existing calendar instead of taking control of it like Motion does.
cons: Less aggressive than full AI planners

references.title: Motion vs Reclaim: 2026 Review & Side-by-Side Comparison
